comment: The disk box on the page. file: image path relative to the project root (staged gzipped by web/tools/build-site.mjs; a missing file shows as an empty sleeve). colour: the diskette's plastic; label: the paper label's colour stripe. writeProtected: the tab is open. Order = order in the box.

disks.label: ARM-DOS 4.00
disks.description: The system diskette, with DOS on it like a setup disk. Boot from it; FORMAT C: /S and then INSTALL leave you a fresh, empty ARM-DOS on the hard disk (Reset C: to factory brings the original back).

disks.label: Blank
disks.description: An empty, formatted diskette. Copy something onto it, then take it home with Download.
